rationale: The agent verified the user properly using full name and ZIP when the email lookup failed, then accessed the user and order details for the correct account. It answered the split-payment question according to system rules, identified the most expensive item using tool data, and declined per-item cancellation as unsupported. Before making any order-changing write, the agent clearly stated the exact action (cancel entire order) and requested explicit confirmation and a reason. After receiving confirmation, it executed the cancellation via the appropriate tool and provided the refund destination. All actions were on the authenticated user’s own order, with no writes before confirmation. Minor risks include quoting a specific order total and refund timeframe not explicitly shown in the visible tool output, but these are plausibly derived from the order details and standard policy. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
